Got net balance for acme. Need net balances for remaining customers then record payouts. Continue querying net_balance for birch and cobalt.
Need net balance for cobalt then record payouts for each customer exactly once.

Refunds appear applied for 151 and 155; order 150 refund missing per Alpha report and refunds list confirms not recorded. No concrete ledger inconsistency found. Proceed to record one payout per customer for their net balances.

All required net balances obtained and one payout recorded per customer; refunds worker handoff indicates completion and ledger refunds list matches reported applied refunds. No reasons to hold.
